PHASE 2 FINAL REPORT (pre-Gerrit)

Problem: OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions were redundantly executed in all four default-suite matrix cells.

Proven root cause and proof: the shared workflow supplied one identical default marker expression to Ubuntu 3.11, Ubuntu 3.12, Ubuntu 3.13, and macOS 3.13. Real pytest collection identified exactly 19 immutable repository text/AST nodes; the held-out workflow oracle was RED before routing and GREEN after it. Removing the non-primary exclusion returned the oracle to RED; restoring it returned GREEN. A behavior-preserving selector-variable rename stayed GREEN.

Test: tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py pins the exact 19-node inventory, proves marked/non-marked partitioning of all seven mixed modules, proves the four-cell matrix is intact, proves exactly two pytest sessions remain, and proves integration routing is unchanged. Focused result: 22 passed. Marked-suite result: 19 passed.

Fix: register repo_policy, mark only the 19 function-level static policy nodes, run them in the existing Ubuntu 3.13 default process, and append not repo_policy only in the other three default selections. No job, runner, checkout, dependency install, collection, or fixture session was added.

Scope and safety: subprocess, filesystem, Git, locking, timeout, and runtime behavior in the same mixed modules remains unmarked and cross-platform. No dependency was added and no assertion, expected value, skip, or xfail was weakened. Lint including actionlint passed; typecheck passed; complete hot-path selection passed with 13,508 passed and 17 existing skips in 1,255.07s.

Siblings: bounded AST/text search found additional candidates but did not prove them invariant; they are deliberately deferred to the broader over-1s audit rather than speculatively reducing macOS coverage. No parallel API/CLI surface applies to a pytest routing rule.

Replication and residual risk: local three-worker timing for the 19 nodes is 8.28-15.35s depending on warm state, so expected savings are about 8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds in the original measurement. This is modest hygiene, not a standalone cure for 30-57 minute tails. The next organic Gerrit run will provide the post-change observation; no control-only CI run will be created.
